response.original_text:
'HINDI AKO NABABAGAY SA MUNDONG ITO'
LOOK: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla announced on Friday, Sept. 18, that he has no plans of running in future elections, saying he wants to focus on raising his young children and living a quiet Islamic life.
In a Facebook post, Padilla endorsed several allies to run as Vice President Sara Duterte's running mate instead, including Sens. Alan Peter Cayetano, Imee Marcos, Bong Go, and Ronald "Bato" dela Rosa, along with Rep. Rodante Marcoleta and former legal counsel Salvador Panelo.
"Halata naman po na hindi ako nababagay sa mundong ito," Padilla said, concluding with: "Revolutionaries do not sit on thrones; they tear them down."

citations.quote: Senator Robin Padilla said he no longer plans to run for public office, citing his young children and his desire for a quiet Islamic life.
CEBU, Philippines — Gipahibalo ni Sen. Robin Padilla nga wala na siyay plano nga modagan pag-usab sa bisan unsang posisyon sa 2028 elections, ug magpokus na sa iyang pamilya .
Sa iyang Facebook post, matud sa Senador nga gagmay pa ang iyang mga anak ug gusto niya nga makabaton og malinawon nga kinabuhi.
“Wala na po akong planong tumakbo sa pulitika. Maliliit pa ang aking mga anak, at isang tahimik na buhay-Islami ang aking pinapangarap at minimithi,” matud niya.
Sa isang Facebook post nitong Biyernes, Setyembre 18, sinabi niyang tahimik na buhay-Islami lang daw ang kaniyang hinahangad.
“Wala na po akong planong tumakbo sa pulitika.

claims.evidence_context:
'HINDI AKO NABABAGAY SA MUNDONG ITO'
LOOK: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla announced on Friday, Sept. 18, that he has no plans of running in future elections, saying he wants to focus on raising his young children and living a quiet Islamic life.
In a Facebook post, Padilla endorsed several allies to run as Vice President Sara Duterte's running mate instead, including Sens.
Alan Peter Cayetano, Imee Marcos, Bong Go, and Ronald "Bato" dela Rosa, along with Rep. Rodante Marcoleta and former legal counsel Salvador Panelo.
"Halata naman po na hindi ako nababagay sa mundong ito," Padilla said, concluding with: "Revolutionaries do not sit on thrones; they tear them down."
